title: Gloria (Padovano, Missa Domina, a lingua dolosa)
desc: Annibale Padovano, Missa Domina, a lingua dolosa, Gloria. 5 voices (Cantus Primus, Cantus Secundus, Altus, Quintus, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0044_2); edited by Pyrros Bachimas, Vincent Besson, Michael Winter. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
